title: Restore alert detection and notification as a runtime lane

supersedes.note: Implementation ported from PR #1439 head 039a5bf54a6a59aefd2d41ba5e94bf60b46cfbab. That PR remains open and preserved. Its evidence narrative is deliberately NOT carried forward; this bundle is built from commands run against this lane at this head.
supersedes.reason: The superseded lane ran as lane_type governance with proof_profile static while the issue is kind:runtime, which waived the runtime proof requirement this bundle satisfies.

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Commit carrying the three ported implementation surfaces. Later commits in this lane are proof artifacts only.

static_proof.type_check_scope_caveat: scripts/ is outside every tsconfig project reference, so pnpm type-check does not enforce types in this file. The regression guard for the retry column is the test and the live schema assertion below, not the compiler.

r_level_check.detail: 10 changed files; rules matched: (none) — no R-level artifacts required for this diff

queries.name: schema assertion for every column the implementation reads
queries.sql: information_schema.columns left-joined against the exact (table, column) pairs the monitor and alert path read
queries.significance: This is the check the superseded static profile waived. The original defect was a monitor querying provider_offers.updated_at, which does not exist, so the monitor threw and its silence read as health. Every column this implementation reads is asserted present against the live schema.

queries.name: alerting and ingestion freshness state
queries.sql: aggregates over alert_detections, system_runs, provider_cycle_status, game_results
queries.result: alerting last ran 2026-04-28; ingestion last cycle 2026-06-30
queries.significance: Confirms the outage this lane addresses is real and still current, and that the freshness sources the implementation now reads return data.

writable_staging_proof.evidence: CI checks "Writable DB proof (staging only)" and "Require live-DB proof for runtime changes" both succeeded on this head. Produced by CI in the governed staging-ci environment, not asserted by the executor.

safety_posture.member_delivery: UNAUTHORIZED by default. ALERT_MEMBER_CHANNELS_ENABLED is pinned to false in the workflow. Two enforcement layers: member targets withheld from the resolvable map, and the transport refuses any non-canary channel.
safety_posture.sgo_and_ingestion: disabled; the workflow contains zero SGO or ingestion triggers
safety_posture.production: otherwise parked; the only production access in this lane was read-only SQL
